task: Deliver a tiny Python CLI `todo` in this directory (`add <text>`, `list`, `done <id>`); JSON-file persistence. Coordinate via specification -> tests -> implementation -> review. Maintain a shared audit trail workflow-log.jsonl in this directory: one JSON line per substantive worker action, carrying the worker's id.

workers.goal: Write SPEC.md at repo root: command set (add <text>, list, done <id>), JSON-file storage schema and its path, exact stdout for each command, and exit codes for success and error cases (e.g. done on unknown id). Done when every command has a Given/When/Then.

Write a black-box pytest suite test_todo.py at repo root derived only from SPEC.md, invoking the todo CLI as a subprocess (python3 todo.py ...) against a temp JSON store. Cover add, list, done, and the error case(s) SPEC.md defines. Done when the suite collects and fails only because todo.py/implementation is missing.
Implement todo.py at repo root (add/list/done subcommands, JSON-file persistence) so that test_todo.py passes with minimal code, matching SPEC.md exactly. Done when pytest is green.
